seoTitle: How to Change Primary Email on Google Workspace
metaDescription: Learn how to safely change a user's primary email address in Google Workspace in 2026 without losing access to Gmail, Drive, or Calendar.
intro: Whether you need to fix a typo, update a username, or rebrand an account, changing a primary email address in Google Workspace is a task best done carefully to avoid disrupting access. This guide walks through the safest way to do it from the Admin Console.

steps.heading: Log in to the Admin Console
steps.body: Sign in with a super admin account, since primary email changes require admin-level access.

steps.heading: Locate the user
steps.body: Find the account whose primary email you want to change from the Users list.

steps.heading: Change the primary email address
steps.body: Update the username field to the new primary email, which effectively renames the account's main address.

steps.heading: Understand aliases versus primary email
steps.body: Know that an alias is a secondary address that still reaches the same inbox, while the primary email is the account's main identifier used for login.

steps.heading: Confirm access is preserved
steps.body: After the change, verify the user can still log in and access Gmail, Drive, and Calendar without any interruption.

faq.question: Will changing the primary email delete any of the user's data?
faq.answer: No, changing the primary email address doesn't affect existing Gmail, Drive, or Calendar data — it simply updates the account's main login identifier.

faq.question: Can a user change their own primary email address?
faq.answer: This typically requires admin access, so most users will need to request the change from their Workspace admin.

faq.question: What's the difference between an alias and the primary email?
faq.answer: An alias is an additional address that still delivers to the same mailbox, while the primary email is the account's official login and display address.

faq.question: How long does it take for a primary email change to take effect?
faq.answer: The change usually applies quickly, though it can take some time to fully propagate across all connected Google services.
